title: SLICR: Strategy Logic-Guided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27865v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Specification-guided reinforcement learning (RL) translates formal specifications of desired behavior of agents into shaped rewards. This paper introduces SLICR, a significant paradigm shift that advances the state of the art to specification-guided RL in adversarial settings under partial observability. We employ Strategy Logic (SL), which allows explicit quantification over agents' strategies and uses the linear temporal logic (LTL) to specify the agents' objectives and constraints. This enables reasoning not only about how agents should act to satisfy a specification, but also about how they should respond to the strategies and behaviors of other agents. We evaluate SLICR on three popular benchmarks: Predator-Prey, Google Research Football, and our home-grown extension of SMAC-HARD, demonstrating its effectiveness, scalability, and ability to adapt to diverse adversarial strategies.

translated_title: SLICR：策略逻辑引导的多智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 规范引导的强化学习将智能体期望行为的形式化规范转化为整形奖励。本文提出了SLICR，这是一次重大的范式转变，将规范引导强化学习的前沿推进到了部分可观测的对抗性环境中。我们采用策略逻辑（SL），它允许对智能体的策略进行显式量化，并使用线性时序逻辑（LTL）来指定智能体的目标与约束。这使得我们不仅能够推理智能体应如何行动以满足规范，还能推理它们应如何应对其他智能体的策略和行为。我们在三个流行的基准测试上评估了SLICR：捕食者-猎物、Google Research Football以及我们自主开发的SMAC-HARD扩展版本，证明了其有效性、可扩展性以及适应多样化对抗策略的能力。
tldr: 提出SLICR框架，通过策略逻辑将规范引导强化学习首次推进到部分可观测的对抗性多智能体环境，不仅能推理智能体自身如何满足规范，还能推理如何应对其他智能体的策略和行为。
